part.text:
Perfect! I've successfully added a new component that fetches user profile data. Here's what I implemented:

## 1. API Route (`/vercel/sandbox/app/api/users/profile/route.ts`)
- Created a Next.js 13+ route handler that responds to GET requests
- Returns mock user profile data with name and email
- Includes proper TypeScript types and response headers

## 2. Updated UserProfile Component (`/vercel/sandbox/app/UserProfile.tsx`)
- Implemented as an async server component (following the existing pattern from `page.tsx`)
- Uses `fetch('/api/users/profile')` to get user data
- Includes error handling with fallback mock data for build time
- Displays the user's name and email in a clean format
- Follows the same pattern as the existing `ProductList` component

The implementation follows all the existing patterns in your codebase:
- ✅ Server component with async/await pattern
- ✅ No client-side useEffect or state management
- ✅ Proper error handling with fallback data
- ✅ Clean, semantic HTML structure
- ✅ TypeScript interfaces for type safety
